items.reply: The PR adds rejectedEmails, appends server-rejected addresses at line 275, and fails validation for cached matches at lines 69–74 without any invalidation. That failure disables submission even after the server-side block is removed. Intentional caching does not make stale rejection correct; blocking a now-valid signup is observable wrong behavior, not a nit. The uncommon trigger and reload workaround support medium severity.
